# Sebastian Tam — Portfolio

> Growth Leader and AI Architect based in Berkshire, UK

Sebastian Tam specialises in AI-driven marketing systems, B2B SaaS growth strategy, and performance marketing across APAC and Europe.

## Experience

- **Zippe Group**: Head of Growth and Performance Marketing - Developed RAG-based AI systems for market pricing research, marketing creatives management, and CRM compliance
- **AnyMind Group**: Head of Digital Marketing - Led performance marketing across 13 markets and 17 offices globally
- **Metaps**: Director, Alliance - Grew Greater China region from zero to USD $15M+ in 3 years, contributed to Tokyo Stock Exchange listing (2015)
- **RTM**: Director - Self-employed digital marketing consultancy

## Expertise
